title: Add HTTP server shutdown helper
objective: Add a small dependency-free shutdown helper so the local HTTP server can close cleanly in tests, scripts, and signal handlers.
scope: Export a promise-based server shutdown helper
Use the helper in CLI signal handling
Add unit/integration test coverage for shutdown behavior
Record documentation, test evidence, and handoff

acceptance_criteria.description: A promise-based helper closes a running HTTP server cleanly.
Calling the helper with no server is a safe no-op.
The CLI entry point installs SIGINT and SIGTERM shutdown handlers.

required_tests: Integration test that a running server is closed by the shutdown helper
Unit test that no-op shutdown is safe
Regression tests for existing health, 404, logging, and config behavior

reasons: No dependency, persistence, or external API changes
